traps.title: Airport prepaid taxi quote spike
traps.description: A quoted airport fare can jump after luggage is loaded or a night surcharge is invented.
traps.tips: Confirm the all-in fare first or choose the official prepaid counter.

traps.title: AEC campus auto overquote
traps.description: Autos near the campus may quote visitors several times the short-hop local fare.
traps.tips: Ask two drivers, agree the full fare before boarding, and name the exact gate.

traps.title: Jalukbari meter refusal
traps.description: A driver refuses a meter and starts with an inflated fare for a nearby destination.
traps.tips: Confirm the meter or fare before the ride begins.

traps.title: Kamakhya parking add-on
traps.description: A helper offers parking or a shuttle then adds unmentioned per-person charges.
traps.tips: Use marked temple transport and check the complete price.

traps.title: Brahmaputra cruise ticket switch
traps.description: Unofficial sellers redirect visitors to a different, more expensive boat.
traps.tips: Buy at the named operator’s ticket counter and confirm departure time.

traps.title: Fake temple closure diversion
traps.description: A tout says the temple is closed and offers a paid ride to a shop or alternate shrine.
traps.tips: Check with the official gate or visitor desk before changing plans.

traps.title: Unlicensed campus guide
traps.description: A self-appointed guide quotes a low price, then demands a large tip.
traps.tips: Agree the total, duration and stops up front; ask campus staff for directions.

traps.title: Restaurant bill add-ons
traps.description: Water, service or cover charges appear without being clearly explained.
traps.tips: Check the menu prices and ask about extra charges before ordering.

traps.title: Railway station luggage fee
traps.description: A porter or driver invents a per-bag fee after helping with luggage.
traps.tips: Settle the total before accepting help and use marked service counters.

traps.title: Shared ride becomes private fare
traps.description: A shared auto leaves after collecting a private-ride price from one passenger.
traps.tips: Confirm whether the fare is per seat or for the entire vehicle.

traps.title: AEC event-day drop-off confusion
traps.description: A driver quotes one drop-off point, then asks for more after the campus gate or event venue is clarified.
traps.tips: Share the exact gate or venue pin and agree the final fare before the ride starts.

traps.title: Jalukbari shared-auto seat pricing
traps.description: A shared-auto quote may be unclear about whether it is per passenger or for the whole vehicle.
traps.tips: Confirm the per-seat price and destination before boarding.

traps.title: Adabari terminal luggage add-on
traps.description: A quoted local transfer may acquire an extra luggage or waiting fee at departure.
traps.tips: Ask for the all-in price, including luggage and waiting, before loading bags.

traps.title: Campus-to-IITG route detour
traps.description: A cross-river trip may be quoted without clarifying bridge route, traffic time or return plans.
traps.tips: Confirm the route, one-way or return fare, and any waiting time before setting off.

traps.title: Airport pickup meeting-point switch
traps.description: A caller may change the pickup point after a fare is agreed and request an extra fee.
traps.tips: Use a clear terminal meeting point and confirm any pickup fee in the written quote.

traps.title: Event shuttle not clearly priced
traps.description: An informal event shuttle quote may not clarify whether each leg or the full day is included.
traps.tips: Confirm number of trips, per-person or per-vehicle pricing, and the return plan.

traps.title: Riverfront boat duration mismatch
traps.description: A boat ride description may leave the duration, route and included stops unclear.
traps.tips: Confirm the operator, route, duration and full group price at the official counter.

traps.title: Temple guide fee not agreed
traps.description: A visitor may be approached by an unofficial guide before reaching the temple entrance.
traps.tips: Ask temple staff about authorized guides and settle any fee before the tour.

traps.title: Jalukbari rain-route surcharge
traps.description: A short trip may be repriced sharply during rain without a clear route or waiting explanation.
traps.tips: Agree a total fare before boarding and check whether the driver is including a real detour.

traps.title: Bus departure time confusion
traps.description: Travelers may be directed to a different vehicle or departure point without a clear ticket check.
traps.tips: Confirm the route and boarding point with the operator or terminal staff before paying.

traps.title: Deepor Beel guide bundle unclear
traps.description: An informal nature visit quote may bundle transport, guiding and boat access without separate prices.
traps.tips: Ask which services are included and check site access conditions before paying.

traps.title: Police Bazaar taxi overquote
traps.description: A short city trip is quoted at a peak tourist rate without a clear reason.
traps.tips: Ask a local shop or hotel for the usual fare before accepting.

traps.title: Umiam Lake photo fee
traps.description: A photo stop is presented as free then billed as a mandatory service.
traps.tips: Ask whether the stop or photos cost extra before agreeing.

traps.title: Unlicensed falls guide
traps.description: A guide claims a ticket requires a separate guide fee.
traps.tips: Buy entry at the official booth and agree guide terms in advance.

traps.title: Airport transfer add-on
traps.description: A driver adds an unmentioned luggage or waiting charge at drop-off.
traps.tips: Confirm a complete one-way price before the journey.

traps.title: Closed viewpoint diversion
traps.description: A driver claims a viewpoint is closed and offers a commission stop.
traps.tips: Verify opening status with the site or your accommodation.

traps.title: Station auto fare jump
traps.description: A short ride is priced as an out-of-town transfer after arrival.
traps.tips: Name the destination and confirm the total before boarding.

traps.title: Airport waiting charge
traps.description: Drivers add a waiting fee even when pickup was on time.
traps.tips: Agree pickup timing and any waiting fees when booking.

traps.title: Market guide commission
traps.description: An unsolicited guide leads visitors to a shop and expects a commission tip.
traps.tips: Decline unsolicited guiding and ask vendors for directions.

traps.title: Meter not running
traps.description: A taxi shows a meter but does not start it before moving.
traps.tips: Check that the meter is reset and running before departure.

traps.title: Restaurant menu mismatch
traps.description: A verbal special differs from the price shown on the final bill.
traps.tips: Confirm the written price and retain your receipt.

traps.title: Airport taxi fixed fare
traps.description: A high fixed fare is quoted without explaining the distance or inclusions.
traps.tips: Compare the posted counter fare and agree the total first.

traps.title: Loktak tour exclusions
traps.description: A tour quote leaves out boat fees, entry or return transport.
traps.tips: Request a written itinerary with all fees included.

traps.title: Kangla guide pressure
traps.description: A guide offers a quick tour then asks for an extra tip at the exit.
traps.tips: Agree a fixed total and duration before starting.

traps.title: Closed market claim
traps.description: A tout says the market is closed and redirects visitors to a shop.
traps.tips: Check the official market entrance or local opening hours.

traps.title: Auto fare by passenger
traps.description: Drivers quote different prices based on whether a traveler appears local.
traps.tips: Confirm the route and fare with more than one driver.

traps.title: Kisama festival transfer premium
traps.description: Festival transport prices rise sharply without a posted rate.
traps.tips: Ask the event help desk about current shuttle fares.

traps.title: War Cemetery guide fee
traps.description: Visitors are asked to pay an unofficial guide fee at the entrance.
traps.tips: Check with cemetery staff; entry and guiding are separate.

traps.title: Shared taxi seat confusion
traps.description: A fare quoted per vehicle is later charged per passenger, or vice versa.
traps.tips: Confirm whether the price is per seat or for the whole ride.

traps.title: Out-of-town route detour
traps.description: A driver takes a longer route and adds a distance surcharge.
traps.tips: Agree the route and fare; follow along on your map.

traps.title: Unlisted luggage charge
traps.description: A luggage fee is added only at the destination.
traps.tips: Ask about luggage charges before setting off.

traps.title: Naharlagun station transfer
traps.description: A city transfer is quoted at an inflated outstation rate.
traps.tips: Confirm the destination and compare with the posted taxi stand fare.

traps.title: Airport pickup extra fee
traps.description: An extra pickup charge appears after a fare was already agreed.
traps.tips: Settle the full price and pickup point before travel.

traps.title: Ganga Lake guide upsell
traps.description: A low ride quote becomes a bundled guide and parking charge.
traps.tips: Separate transport, entry and guide prices before agreeing.

traps.title: Unlicensed sightseeing guide
traps.description: A guide offers a free introduction and later demands payment.
traps.tips: Ask for credentials and a fixed price before a tour.

traps.title: Meter switched off
traps.description: A metered trip is charged as an arbitrary flat fare at the end.
traps.tips: Confirm the meter is on or settle the fare before departure.

traps.title: MNIT campus short-trip overquote
traps.location: MNIT Jaipur main gate, JLN Marg
traps.description: A short ride from the campus can be quoted as a full-city trip, especially for visitors unfamiliar with Malviya Nagar.
traps.tips: Confirm the destination, total fare and whether the quote is per vehicle before boarding.

traps.title: Jawahar Circle parking add-on
traps.description: A parking or waiting charge may be added after an initial drop-off quote.
traps.tips: Agree on waiting time and any parking charge before the ride.

traps.title: Pink City guide price not agreed
traps.description: An informal guide may begin a tour before explaining the full fee.
traps.tips: Use an authorized guide and settle the duration and complete price first.

traps.title: Amer Fort return fare unclear
traps.description: A low one-way quote can become an unexpectedly high return or waiting charge.
traps.tips: Confirm whether the fare is one-way, return, and includes waiting.

traps.title: Airport pickup fee surprise
traps.description: A pickup or parking fee may be introduced after a ride price is agreed.
traps.tips: Set the full pickup price and meeting point before the trip.
